outcome.technical: drive-phase.py: new held_green_moved(ctx, state, manifest, task, tree) asks, at the filing, whether the gated mark's green run still holds for the tree being filed - stored_green (gate digest and tree; spends a moved mark) and _verdict_binding.digest_binding (the run's testedState.scopeDigest against the declared files now, under member_project(ctx, tree) or the project; the committer's own comparison). A digest that cannot be compared does not hold. New regate_moved_green spends the gated mark and runs gate_step when the held run does not hold; file_writer_return calls it before gate_binding for a by-gate proof, so a red re-gate files nothing and a green one is what binds. gate_binding takes tree and re-asks held_green_moved itself (a run that moved again since binds nothing and the helper makes the fix leg). The basis clause no longer says 'on the implementation the return is filed with'; it says the run's recorded digest of the declared files matches them as filed. Docstrings/comments corrected: module docstring, writer_prove comment, tree_since_proof docstring, file_writer_return INVARIANT comment. execute-task.md (writer path step 4 and the 'A proof is filed only over the HEAD...' paragraph) and PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md (drive-phase.py section) now name held_green_moved/regate_moved_green and the two questions. changelog.d/P173.17-s6m.fixed.md added. tests/test_drive_phase.py: _fix_by_gate_moved_units / _fix_by_gate_moved_filings (fbm0-fbm4) over a scratch project with real declared files; filed_over's rows in _fix_by_gate_filing_units now carry testedState.scopeDigest of the declared files as they stand (the binding now requires it). Dependants: file_writer_return - changed (re-gates before binding); settle_aside - still correct, unchanged (it re-proves then calls gate_step with a rerun mark and binds nothing); tree_since_proof - behaviour unchanged (by-gate proofs still not drifted by an implementation edit, fbg8/fbg9 green), docstring now points at the bound run's check; plugins/audit/hooks/drive-without-model.py and other importers - no signature they call changed (gate_binding gained an optional tree kwarg; its only caller is file_writer_return); execute-task.md's dependants (prove-gates.py, test_run_test_gate.py prose ref etc.) - no anchored text they read was changed (git grep of tests/ and tools/ for the edited sentences: no hits); PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md dependants - the drive-phase.py section heading unchanged. outcome.descriptive: A fix-by-gate filing now binds only a gate run whose gate and declared-file digest still match the tree being filed, re-gating first when they do not.
